title: Task Manager API
description: Build a task manager API with validation, status filtering, and full CRUD operations.

steps.title: List all tasks
steps.description: Create a GET /tasks endpoint that returns an array of tasks. Start with one sample task.

Use app.get('/tasks', handler) to respond with the array

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel
from datetime import datetime
import os

app = FastAPI()
port = int(os.getenv('PORT', 3000))

class TaskIn(BaseModel):
    title: str

class Task(BaseModel):
    id: int
    title: str
    completed: bool = False
    createdAt: datetime = datetime.now()

tasks = [Task(id=1, title='Sample task')]
next_id = 2

@app.get('/tasks')
def list_tasks():
    return tasks

@app.post('/tasks', status_code=201)
def create_task(task: TaskIn):
    global next_id
    new_task = Task(id=next_id, title=task.title)
    next_id += 1
    tasks.append(new_task)
    return new_task
